_specs: Fabric, fit, weight, features and care are verbatim from the copy skill's Product Reference Guide (The Classic Polo). Body measurements are NOT published anywhere verifiable and are not invented — the size table carries dashes and says why.
_voice: The reference guide is explicit that apparel does NOT get the clubs' value-comparison framing. No middlemen-and-markups argument on any polo page.

fabric.v: Four-way, so it moves in every direction the swing does.

sizeHeadline: Get the size right the first time
sizeSub: The Classic runs tailored athletic — closer to the body than a traditional golf polo, but not compression. If you are between sizes or you like room across the chest, take the larger one.
sizeNote: The measurements above are not published anywhere we can verify, so they are left visibly empty rather than guessed at. They are the single most useful thing that could be added to these pages — wrong size is the most common reason apparel is returned, and a table of dashes does not prevent that.
fitParas: Tailored athletic. It follows the shoulders and tapers slightly through the body, so it sits closer than a traditional boxy golf polo without restricting the swing.
The four-way stretch means the fit is more forgiving than the cut suggests. If you normally wear a large in a performance polo, a large here is right.
Between sizes, or want room across the chest? Size up. Returns are thirty days, unworn with the tags on, so an exchange is straightforward — but the guide above is worth thirty seconds first.
sibHeadline: The same polo, nine other ways
closeBody: $67 in every size, four-way stretch, UPF 50+. Thirty days to send it back unworn if the fit isn't right.
